description: JSON, string, math and list functions return exact computed values

steps.name: json functions extract exact values
steps.pattern: \[json-string-math-list-functions\] : Event\{.*data=\[json, ev-{{runId}}, John, 12000\.5, true, true, false, Colombo\]

steps.name: string functions transform exactly
steps.pattern: \[json-string-math-list-functions\] : Event\{.*data=\[str, ev-{{runId}}, HELLO WORLD, Hello World-ev-{{runId}}, Hell0 W0rld, 11, World\]

steps.name: list functions build and read lists exactly
steps.pattern: \[json-string-math-list-functions\] : Event\{.*data=\[list, ev-{{runId}}, 3, 4, y, w, true, false\]
